summary.problem: Tracker task files are stored directly under the project temp directory rather than within the session-specific directory.
summary.root_cause: Storage.getProjectTempTrackerDir() in packages/core/src/config/storage.ts does not check for this.sessionId, unlike getProjectTempPlansDir and getProjectTempTasksDir.
summary.context: Storing tracker tasks outside the session directory prevents session-level isolation and automatic cleanup when a session is deleted or expired.

steps: In packages/core/src/config/storage.ts, update getProjectTempTrackerDir() to check if this.sessionId is present.
If this.sessionId exists, return path.join(this.getProjectTempDir(), this.sessionId, 'tracker').

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: getProjectTempTrackerDir() returns path.join(tempDir, 'tracker') when no sessionId is set, and path.join(tempDir, sessionId, 'tracker') when sessionId is provided.
verification_steps: Add a unit test in packages/core/src/config/storage.test.ts verifying getProjectTempTrackerDir without sessionId returns path.join(tempDir, 'tracker').
Add a unit test in packages/core/src/config/storage.test.ts verifying getProjectTempTrackerDir with sessionId returns path.join(tempDir, sessionId, 'tracker').

github_metadata.title: Fix path where tracker tasks are stored
